metadata.name: mememarkets
metadata.description: Yes or no prediction markets for Solana memecoins, bets in USDC

instructions.name: add_bonus
docs: Bonus pot: anyone (normally the platform treasury, funded by creator fees) adds USDC to a
market without taking a side. No shares are minted and no position is created, so the funder
cannot win it back. It is split evenly across the outcome reserves, which means the winners
receive it on resolution (and on a void each outcome's holders get its share back).
Only while the market is Pending or Open.

instructions.name: buy_shares
docs: Buy shares of one outcome with `usdc_in` USDC at the curve price. Reverts if fewer than
`min_shares_out` shares would be received (slippage guard). Only while Open, before the deadline.

instructions.name: cancel_pending
docs: The creator can pull a market that nobody approved yet. The seed is refunded through claim.

instructions.name: claim
docs: Pays a winner, or refunds a stake on a void or rejected market. Pays the signer's own wallet only.

instructions.name: claim_creator_fee
docs: Pays the market creator's fee share into the creator's own USDC account. Anyone can call it
(normally the watcher), once, after collect_fees.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone. Pays only the transaction fee; receives nothing.

instructions.name: claim_for
docs: Automatic payout: anyone (normally the price watcher) can pay a holder's payout or refund
into that holder's own USDC account. The money can only go to a token account owned by the
position's owner, so the caller cannot redirect it. Same rules and timing as claim.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone. Pays only the transaction fee; receives nothing.

accounts.name: owner
docs: owner_usdc. Does not sign and receives nothing directly.

instructions.name: collect_fees
docs: Sends the platform fee, once per market: on a resolved market after the dispute window, or on
a void or rejected market (sweeps reserves of outcomes nobody holds). The market's creator
share of that fee stays in the vault as creator_fee_owed for claim_creator_fee.

instructions.name: create_market
docs: Creates a market with 2 or 3 outcomes and buys the creator's first shares.
Admin created markets open right away and are Verified. Other markets open right away when
creation is open, otherwise they wait in Pending for admin approval.
rules_hash commits to the market's full rules text (sha256), so the wording cannot change later.

instructions.name: dispute_market
docs: Any holder in the market can freeze payouts during the dispute window.

instructions.name: emergency_void
docs: Safety valve. If nobody resolves (open or locked), or nobody settles a dispute, anyone can
void the market after a delay. Everyone is then refunded.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: One time setup, only by the program's upgrade authority. Market creation starts closed
(admin approval needed) with no creator fee share.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Must be the program's upgrade authority, so nobody can front run the setup after deploy.

instructions.name: lock_market
docs: Freezes trading the moment the target looks hit, so nobody can trade on a known outcome
while the resolver confirms it. The lock time is kept in resolved_ts while Locked.

instructions.name: reject_market
docs: Rejected markets refund every position (the creator seed) through claim.

instructions.name: resolve_market
docs: Sets the outcome. result: 1..=outcome_count, or 4 to void.
After the deadline: from Open or Locked, any result.
Before the deadline: only from Locked (trading already frozen). In a 2 outcome market only
Yes can resolve early, since No means the target was not hit in time.
final_value is the value the resolver read off chain, stored for the public record.

instructions.name: sell_shares
docs: Cash out: sell `shares` back to the curve at the current price, minus the market fee, which
stays in the pot for the eventual winners. Reverts if the user would get less than
`min_usdc_out`. Only while Open, before the deadline.

instructions.name: set_creation
docs: Staged rollout switches. open_creation: user created markets go live without approval.
creator_fee_share_bps: share of each market's platform fee paid to its creator (0 to 10000,
copied into each market at creation). Markets the admin creates never pay a creator share.

instructions.name: set_curve
docs: Price curve for new markets: starting share price (USDC base units) and depth
(share units per 1 base unit of price rise). Existing markets keep their curve.

instructions.name: set_limits
docs: min_bet is the smallest buy, max_bet the most a wallet can have in one market (cost basis).
Limits apply to new trades. Fee and dispute window apply to new markets only.

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Kill switch. Pauses new markets and all buying and selling. Claims and refunds always keep working.

instructions.name: set_resolver
docs: Sets the resolver: a second key (for the price watcher server) that can only lock, unlock and
resolve markets. Pass the zero key to turn it off. Admin keeps every power.

instructions.name: set_verified
docs: Admin marks a market as Verified (official, promoted) or removes the badge. Display only.

instructions.name: settle_dispute
docs: Admin decides a dispute: 1..=outcome_count, or 4 to void. Payouts open right away after.

instructions.name: unlock_market
docs: False alarm: reopen trading. Only before the deadline.

instructions.name: void_market
docs: Admin can cancel an open or locked market at any time, for example a rugged token or
manipulation. Everyone is refunded.

errors.name: BadSide
errors.msg: That outcome does not exist in this market

errors.name: BadAmount
errors.msg: Amount is outside the allowed range

errors.name: BadDeadline
errors.msg: Deadline must be 1 hour to 90 days away

errors.name: BadStatus
errors.msg: Market is not in the right status

errors.name: BettingClosed
errors.msg: Trading is closed for this market

errors.name: OtherSide
errors.msg: You hold shares of another outcome in this market. Sell them first

errors.name: OverMax
errors.msg: Over the per wallet maximum for this market

errors.name: Slippage
errors.msg: Price moved: you would get less than your minimum

errors.name: NotEnoughShares
errors.msg: You do not have that many shares

fields.name: curve_base
docs: Starting share price for new markets, USDC base units per whole share.

fields.name: curve_depth
docs: Share units bought per 1 base unit of price rise, for new markets.

fields.name: open_creation
docs: When true, markets created by anyone go live without admin approval.

fields.name: creator_fee_share_bps
docs: Share of each new user created market's platform fee paid to its creator, in bps of the fee.

fields.name: result
docs: Winning outcome (1..=outcome_count) once Resolved, 0 before.

fields.name: outcome_count
docs: 2 (Yes, No) or 3.

fields.name: reserves
docs: USDC held for each outcome: bought in minus sold out, plus sell fees and bonus. Unused slots are 0.

fields.name: shares
docs: Share supply per outcome (share units, 1_000_000 per share).

fields.name: curve_base
docs: Price curve copied from config at creation.

fields.name: creator_fee_bps
docs: Creator's share of the platform fee, in bps of the fee, copied at creation (0 for admin markets).

fields.name: creator_fee_owed
docs: Creator share set aside by collect_fees, paid by claim_creator_fee.

fields.name: dispute_secs
docs: Dispute window copied from config at creation.

fields.name: resolved_ts
docs: Time of the last lock, resolve or void. Holds the lock time while Locked.

fields.name: verified
docs: Official market badge. True for markets the admin created, admin can change it.

fields.name: rules_hash
docs: sha256 of the market's full rules text, fixed at creation.

types.name: MarketBonus
docs: Running total of bonus USDC added to one market, PDA ["bonus", market]. Informational: payouts
already include the bonus through the reserves. Lets the app show it and exclude it from odds.

fields.name: side
docs: Outcome held, 1..=outcome_count.

fields.name: shares
docs: Shares held (share units).

fields.name: cost
docs: Net USDC put in (cost basis), reduced in proportion when shares are sold. For limits and P&L.

fields.name: resolver
docs: Key allowed to lock, unlock and resolve. Zero key means no resolver.

fields.name: buy
docs: true for a buy, false for a sell (cash out)

fields.name: usdc
docs: USDC paid in (buy) or paid out after the fee (sell)

fields.name: prices
docs: Spot price per outcome after the trade, USDC base units per whole share (0 for unused slots)
